note: Per-character bot state, globs relative to the instance dir (cmd/d2bot: ip.Goals, Deaths, Routes, Ledger, State()). U: the journey file name is a glob guess. The loot rules store (state/ladder/lootrules-<profile>.json and its .bak) is per character, so each hero keeps its own set and a new hero starts from its class preset. Everything else (onboarding.json is keyed by hero, visit.json, currency, ladder, sessions, layout-*, proposals-*, bestiary-* are profile level) stays shared.
